summary.headline: Jupiter and Mars in Terms
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Jupiter in the terms of Mars, Venus, and Mercury, describing dangers, fortune, marriage, service, wealth, religious interests, and effects when Jupiter is in his house. Chapter XXII then begins on the significations of Mars in his own and others’ terms, including military companionship, honor, discord, royal anger, and escape from danger.
